variantrule.name: Poisons
entries: Given their insidious and deadly nature, these alchemical substances are banned in most civilized lands. But it remains a favorite tool among assassins, aberrant horrors, and other evil creatures.
Poisons come in the following four types:

entries.name: Contact
entries: Contact poison can be smeared on an object as an {@variantrule Action|XPHB} and remains potent until it is touched or washed off. A creature that touches contact poison with exposed skin suffers its effects.

entries.name: Ingested
entries: A creature must swallow an entire dose of ingested poison to suffer its effects. The dose can be delivered in food or a liquid. The GM may decide that a partial dose has a reduced effect, such as allowing {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the saving throw or dealing only half as much damage on a failed save.

entries.name: Inhaled
entries: Poisonous powders and gases take effect when inhaled. Blowing the powder or releasing the gas subjects creatures in a 5-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} to its effect. The resulting cloud dissipates immediately afterward. Holding one's breath is ineffective against inhaled poisons, as they affect nasal membranes, tear ducts, and other parts of the body.

entries.name: Injury
entries: Injury poison can be applied as an {@variantrule Action|XPHB} to a weapon, a piece of ammunition, or similar object. The poison remains potent until delivered through a wound or washed off. A creature that takes damage from an object coated with the poison is exposed to its effects.

entries.name: Crafting Poisons
entries: Characters can harvest poisons from creatures. This applies only to poisons whose sole required ingredient is the creature's own venom. These are marked as Crafting: Creature ({@creature Purple Worm|XMM}) for example. A character can attempt to harvest poison from a venomous creature that is dead or has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition. The effort takes {@dice 1d6} minutes, after which the character makes a {@dc 20} Intelligence ({@skill Nature|XPHB}) check using a {@item Poisoner's Kit|XPHB}. On a successful check, the character harvests enough poison for one dose, and no additional poison can be taken from that creature. On a failed check, the character cannot extract any poison, and if the check fails by 5 or more, the character is subjected to the creature's poison.

Some poisons are more complex and require additional ingredients gathered through foraging or purchased from specialized shops. To craft such a poison, a character must first obtain all required ingredients. They then make a {@item Poisoner's Kit|XPHB} check, using either Intelligence ({@skill Nature|XPHB}) or Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand|XPHB}) against the poison's Crafting DC. On a success, the character produces one dose of the poison. On a failure, no dose is created. In either case, all ingredients are consumed in the attempt.

entries.name: Foraging
entries: A character can attempt to forage for ingredients while traveling or during downtime. The effort takes 1 hour, after which the character makes a Wisdom ({@skill Survival|XPHB}) check using a {@item Poisoner's Kit|XPHB} against the ingredient's Foraging DC. On a successful check, the character finds a number of units of the ingredients listed on the {@table Foraging Table|PoisonRework}. If the character exceeds the DC by 5 or more, the character instead finds two units. On a failed check, the character finds no useful ingredients. If the character fails the check by 5 or more, they suffer a minor mishap such as disturbing hazardous plants or creatures, taking {@damage 1d8} damage or triggering a small environmental danger as determined by the DM.

feat.name: Poisoner
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Potent Poison
entries: When you make a damage roll that deals Poison damage, it ignores {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Poison damage.

entries.name: Brew Poison
entries: You gain proficiency with the {@item Poisoner's Kit|XPHB} and have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on any checks made with those tools to harvest or create poisons from the {@table Poison Table|PoisonRework}. In addition when you harvest or create such a poison, instead of creating a single dose, you create a number of doses equal to the Poisoner Doses (listed in the table). If the created poison requires a DC you can replace it by a number equal to 8 + the modifier of the ability increased by this feat + your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}.

item.name: Assassin's Blood
entries: A creature subjected to Assassin's Blood makes a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 6 ({@damage 1d12}) Poison damage and has the {@condition Poisoned} condition for 24 hours. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage only.
{@b {@feat Poisoner|PoisonRework}:} {@dice 1d8} doses
{@b Crafting:} 100 GP worth of alchemical ingredients and 2 vials of Ranitomeya.
{@b Crafting DC:} 12

item.name: Burnt Othur Fumes
entries: A creature subjected to Burnt Othur Fumes must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Poison damage, and it must repeat the save at the start of each of its turns. On each successive failed save, the creature takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Poison damage. After three successful saves, the poison ends.
{@b {@feat Poisoner|PoisonRework}:} {@dice 1d6} doses
{@b Crafting:} Cost 450 GP worth of alchemical ingredients and 3 bulbs of Ashrot Lilies
{@b Crafting DC:} 14

item.name: Essence of Ether
entries: A creature subjected to Essence of Ether must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Unconscious} condition for 8 hours. The creature wakes up if it takes damage or if another creature takes an action to shake it awake.
{@b {@feat Poisoner|PoisonRework}:} {@dice 1d4} doses
{@b Crafting:} 200 GP worth of ether dust and 1 vial of starlake water
{@b Crafting DC:} 14

item.name: Malice
entries: A creature subjected to Malice must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Poisoned} condition for 1 hour. The creature also has the {@condition Blinded} condition while {@condition Poisoned} in this way. Malice ignores {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Poisoned} condition.
{@b {@feat Poisoner|PoisonRework}:} {@dice 1d6} doses
{@b Crafting:} 200 GP worth of ground devil teeth, mixed with a flameblossom leaf-infused tea made from 2 flameblossoms
{@b Crafting DC:} 14

item.name: Midnight Tears
entries: A creature that ingests Midnight Tears suffers no effect until the stroke of midnight. If the poison hasn't been neutralized before midnight, the creature makes a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw, taking 31 ({@damage 9d6}) Poison damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Midnight Tears ignores {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} and {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Poison damage as well as {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Poisoned} condition.
{@b {@feat Poisoner|PoisonRework}:} {@dice 1d4} doses
{@b Crafting:} 1000 GP worth of finely ground diamond, 3 banshee tears, and three dragon scales.
{@b Crafting DC:} 18

item.name: Oil of Taggit
entries: A creature subjected to Oil of Taggit must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Poisoned} condition for 24 hours. The creature also has the {@condition Unconscious} condition while {@condition Poisoned} in this way. It wakes up if it takes damage.
{@b {@feat Poisoner|PoisonRework}:} {@dice 1d2} doses
{@b Crafting:} 350 GP and 12 seeds of jequirity bean
{@b Crafting DC:} 14

item.name: Pale Tincture
entries: A creature subjected to Pale Tincture must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or take 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Poison damage and have the {@condition Poisoned} condition. The {@condition Poisoned} creature repeats the save every 24 hours, taking 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Poison damage on a failed save. The damage the poison deals can't be healed by any means while the creature remains {@condition Poisoned}. After seven successful saves against the poison, the creature is no longer {@condition Poisoned}. Pale Tincture ignores {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} and {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Poison damage as well as {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Poisoned} condition.
{@b {@feat Poisoner|PoisonRework}:} {@dice 1d6} doses
{@b Crafting:} 200 GP worth of alchemical supplies and 4 bulbs of icerose
{@b Crafting DC:} 12

item.name: Purple Worm Poison
entries: A creature subjected to Purple Worm Poison makes a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw, taking 35 ({@damage 10d6}) Poison damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
{@b {@feat Poisoner|PoisonRework}:} {@dice 1d4} doses
{@b Crafting:} Creature: {@creature Purple Worm|XMM}

item.name: Serpent Venom
entries: A creature subjected to Serpent Venom must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw, taking 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Poison damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
{@b {@feat Poisoner|PoisonRework}:} {@dice 1d8} doses
{@b Crafting:} Creature: {@creature Venomous Snake|XMM}
{@b Crafting DC:} 12

item.name: Basic Poison
entries: A creature subjected to Basic Poison must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or take {@damage 2d8} Poison damage and have the {@condition Poisoned} condition until the end of your next turn.
{@b {@feat Poisoner|PoisonRework}:} {@dice 1d10} doses
{@b Crafting:} 50 GP worth of alchemical supplies
{@b Crafting DC:} 12

item.name: Spider's Sting
entries: A creature subjected to Spider's Sting must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Poisoned} condition for 1 hour. If the creature fails the save by 5 or more, the creature also has the {@condition Unconscious} condition while {@condition Poisoned} in this way. The creature wakes up if it takes damage or if another creature takes an action to shake it awake.
{@b {@feat Poisoner|PoisonRework}:} {@dice 1d8} doses
{@b Crafting:} 150 GP worth of alchemical supplies, 1 vial of spider spit and 10 snowpoppy seeds
{@b Crafting DC:} 12

item.name: Torpor
entries: A creature subjected to Torpor poison must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Poisoned} condition for 24 hours. The creature's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is halved while the creature is {@condition Poisoned} in this way.
{@b {@feat Poisoner|PoisonRework}:} {@dice 1d6} doses
{@b Crafting:} 550 GP worth of alchemical supplies
{@b Crafting DC:} 14

item.name: Truth Serum
entries: A creature subjected to Truth Serum must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Poisoned} condition for 1 hour. The {@condition Poisoned} creature can't knowingly communicate a lie. The Truth Serum ignores {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Poisoned} condition.
{@b {@feat Poisoner|PoisonRework}:} {@dice 1d8} doses
{@b Crafting:} 100 GP worth of alchemical supplies, 5 mistletoe berries and 1 vial of starlake water
{@b Crafting DC:} 12

item.name: Wyvern Poison
entries: A creature subjected to Wyvern Poison makes a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw, taking 24 ({@damage 7d6}) Poison damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
{@b {@feat Poisoner|PoisonRework}:} {@dice 1d4} doses
{@b Crafting:} Creature: {@creature Wyvern|XMM}

item.name: Witchfinder's Kiss
entries: A creature subjected to Witchfinder's Kiss makes a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Poison damage and has the {@condition Poisoned} condition for 1 hour. Whenever a creature casts a spell while {@condition Poisoned} in this way, it takes {@damage 1d6} Poison damage per level of the spell cast. The creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
{@b {@feat Poisoner|PoisonRework}:} {@dice 1d6} doses
{@b Crafting:} 400 GP worth of ghoul bile, blackwort root, and a pinch of silver dust.
{@b Crafting DC:} 14

item.name: Coldsnap
entries: A creature subjected to Coldsnap must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Poisoned} condition for 1 hour.

Whenever the creature takes damage while {@condition Poisoned} in this way, one of its limbs succumbs to cold until the end of its next turn, as though that limb was lost. The creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Coldsnap ignores {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Poisoned} condition.

entries.name: Arm
entries: You can't hold anything with two hands and you can hold only a single object at a time.

entries.name: Both Arms
entries: You can't hold anything.

entries.name: Leg
entries: Your base {@variantrule Speed|XPHB|Walking Speed} is reduced to 5 feet. If you still have at least one leg, you can use a crutch or cane to move at half your original base speed.

entries.name: Both Legs
entries: Your only movement option is to crawl.
{@b {@feat Poisoner|PoisonRework}:} {@dice 1d4} doses
{@b Crafting:} 300 GP worth of ice wyrm saliva, powdered icerose, and 1 frost giant's heart.
{@b Crafting DC:} 15

item.name: Leyline Liquour
entries: A creature subjected to Leyline Liquour makes a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 4 ({@damage 1d6}) Poison damage and has the {@condition Poisoned} condition for 1 minute. Whenever a creature casts a spell while {@condition Poisoned} in this way, it must roll on the Wild Magic Surge table to create a magical effect. Once a creature has switched planes three times due to this effect, it is no longer {@condition Poisoned}. Leyline Liquour ignores {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Poisoned} condition.
{@b {@feat Poisoner|PoisonRework}:} {@dice 1d8} doses
{@b Crafting:} 200 GP worth of arcanum, 3 spoons of feywild honey, and a splash of chilli oil.
{@b Crafting DC:} 12

item.name: Planar Ash
entries: A creature subjected to Planar Ash makes a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 13 ({@damage 2d12}) Force damage. For the next minute, at the start of each of its turns, it must roll {@dice 1d6}. On a 1-3, it takes 7 ({@damage 1d12}) Force damage and is teleported to the Ethereal Plane until the end of its turn.
{@b {@feat Poisoner|PoisonRework}:} {@dice 1d4} doses
{@b Crafting:} 1 gilded attunement rod worth at least 500 GP, which the crafting doesn't consume, and 200 GP worth of arcanum.
{@b Crafting DC:} 15

item.name: Candlemoth Dust
entries: A creature subjected to Candlemoth Dust must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or begin glowing with bioluminescent light for the next 10 minutes. While glowing it emits {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} within a 5-foot radius, can't have the {@condition Invisible} condition and attacks against it can't have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.
{@b {@feat Poisoner|PoisonRework}:} {@dice 1d10} doses
{@b Crafting:} 200 GP worth of alchemical supplies, 10 candlemoth wings, and 3 powdered glowcap fungi
{@b Crafting DC:} 14

item.name: Ballooning Bile
entries: A creature subjected to Ballooning Bile must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Poisoned} condition for 1 minute. While {@condition Poisoned} in this way, the creature becomes one size larger at the start of each of its turns, taking 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Force damage if it can't comfortably fit within the space around it. If the creature drops to 0 HP while under this effect, it bursts violently, dealing 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Acid damage to all creatures within 5 feet. The creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
{@b {@feat Poisoner|PoisonRework}:} {@dice 1d6} doses
{@b Crafting:} 300 GP worth of alchemical supplies, 3 slaads' gas bladder sacs and 1 vial of fermented troll's bile.
{@b Crafting DC:} 15

item.name: Nocthelian Sunset
entries: A creature subjected to Nocthelian Sunset must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Poisoned} condition for 1 hour. While {@condition Poisoned} in this way, the creature has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on saving throws made while in {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB}, and whenever it enters {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} for the first time on its turn, it takes 11 ({@damage 3d6}) Radiant damage. The creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. After three successful saves, the poison ends. Nocthelian ignores {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Poisoned} condition if the target is a Fiend or an Undead.
{@b {@feat Poisoner|PoisonRework}:} {@dice 1d8} doses
{@b Crafting:} 500 GP worth of alchemical supplies, 5 vials vampire blood and 3 vials of holy water.
{@b Crafting DC:} 16

item.name: Sorothena
entries: A creature subjected to Sorothena must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or take 18 ({@damage 5d6}) Psychic damage and have the {@condition Charmed} condition for 1 hour. While {@condition Charmed} in this way, the creature is compelled to destroy itself. At the start of each of its turns, it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Charisma saving throw or use its action to attack itself with a weapon attack or Unarmed strike. The creature repeats the save at the end of every minute, ending the effect on itself on a success.
{@b {@feat Poisoner|PoisonRework}:} {@dice 1d4} doses
{@b Crafting:} 1000 GP worth of alchemical supplies, 1 vial banshee tears, 1 vial of virgin's blood and a lich's finger.
{@b Crafting DC:} 17

item.name: Glimpse of Radiance
entries: A creature subjected to Glimpse of Radiance makes a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw, taking 18 ({@damage 5d6}) Radiant damage and gaining a short-term madness on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. If the creature already has at least one madness, it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on this saving throw. Glimpse of Radiance ignores {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Poisoned} condition.
{@b {@feat Poisoner|PoisonRework}:} {@dice 1d6} doses
{@b Crafting:} 600 GP worth of powdered moongold, 1 vial of celestial blood.
{@b Crafting DC:} 17

item.name: Sinsight
entries: A creature subjected to Sinsight suffers no effect until it casts a Divination spell. When it casts the spell, it must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Poisoned} condition for 1 hour. While {@condition Poisoned} in this way, all Divination spells yield false information and the target automatically fails any Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) and Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) checks.
{@b {@feat Poisoner|PoisonRework}:} {@dice 1d4} doses
{@b Crafting:} 450 GP worth of alchemical supplies, 1 beholder eyestalk, and a cursed mirror.
{@b Crafting DC:} 18

item.name: Tincture of Feebleness
entries: A creature subjected to the Tincture of Feebleness must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or gain a {@dice 1d8} penalty to its AC, which lasts for 1 minute. A creature can't be affected by multiple instances of this poison at the same time. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
{@b {@feat Poisoner|PoisonRework}:} {@dice 1d8} Doses
{@b Crafting:} 200 GP worth of alchemical supplies, 1 pound of ground zombie flesh and 2 rust monster's antennae.
{@b Crafting DC:} 13

item.name: Hunter's Call
entries: A creature subjected to Hunter's Call must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or regurgitate a duplicate version of themselves as per the {@spell Simulacrum} spell, except it is {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|XPHB|Hostile} towards them. The duplicate lasts for 24 hours or until it is destroyed.
{@b {@feat Poisoner|PoisonRework}:} {@dice 1d4} Doses
{@b Crafting:} 10,000 GP worth of ruby dust and a mindflayer's brain.
{@b Crafting DC:} 20

item.name: Smoke Shawl
entries: A creature subjected to Smoke Shawl must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or be surrounded by a cloud of smoke for 1 minute. While in the cloud, it is {@variantrule Lightly Obscured|XPHB} and can't target a creature further than 30 feet away with any attack, spell or ability. An affected creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
{@b {@feat Poisoner|PoisonRework}:} {@dice 1d8} Doses
{@b Crafting:} 200 GP worth of alchemical supplies, 1 vial of sea salt ash and 1 vial of fiend's blood.
{@b Crafting DC:} 16

item.name: Wormwine
entries: A creature subjected to Wormwine must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or have its body be infested with worms. For the next 30 days, the creature must consume five times as many rations as normal. For the duration, each day the target fails to consume the necessary rations, its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit point Maximum} is reduced by {@damage 1d10}. This reduction can only be removed by an effect such as {@spell Greater Restoration}.
{@b {@feat Poisoner|PoisonRework}:} {@dice 1d6} doses
{@b Crafting:} 750 GP worth of abyssal larvae, and powdered bone marrow
{@b Crafting DC:} 17

item.name: Brainfog
entries: A creature subjected to Brainfog must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Poisoned} condition for 1 hour. While {@condition Poisoned} in this way, a creature loses its {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} or {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Psychic damage, if it had any, and speak or be spoken to telepathically. The creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
{@b {@feat Poisoner|PoisonRework}:} {@dice 1d6} Doses
{@b Crafting:} 600 GP worth of silk and a mindflayer tadpole
{@b Crafting DC:} 16

item.name: Black Mantis
entries: A creature subjected to Black Mantis must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Poisoned} condition for 1 minute. While {@condition Poisoned} in this way, whenever the creature receives magical healing, it instead takes Necrotic damage equal to the healing received. Once a creature has been damaged in this way three times, it is no longer {@condition Poisoned}.
{@b {@feat Poisoner|PoisonRework}:} {@dice 1d4} Doses
{@b Crafting:} 1000 GP worth of mantis corpses and necrosis-ridden bugbear liver
{@b Crafting DC:} 20

item.name: Midnight Melody
entries: A creature subjected to Midnight Melody must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or have the lyrics to the song used to create this poison implanted in their brain for the next month. When they next hear the song sung by a person, they have the {@condition Charmed} condition for 1 minute. While {@condition Charmed} in this way, they follow the singer's every command as per the {@spell Dominate Person} spell. The poison then ends.
{@b {@feat Poisoner|PoisonRework}:} {@dice 1d4} Doses
{@b Crafting:} 7,000 GP worth of enchanted fey birch shavings and magic paper on which the lyrics of a specific song are written
{@b Crafting DC:} 18

item.name: Icarite
entries: A creature subjected to Icarite must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or have their mind warped for 1 minute. While their mind is warped in this way, the creature uses their movement during each of their turns to climb to the tallest point they can see.
{@b {@feat Poisoner|PoisonRework}:} {@dice 1d6} doses
{@b Crafting:} 750 GP worth of sunwax and feathers
{@b Crafting DC:} 17
